label: R6 · Your attacks
rationale: Five 3/2 tramplers against one untapped blocker (a face-down 2/2) and a tapped Ainok Tracker; the opponent has two red mana, not enough to turn any of their morphs face up. Attacking with everything deals at least 12 (the 2/2 can block one, and trample still pushes 1 through), putting them to 8 or less, while at 14 life you face only a 3/3 and a 2/2 back.
